input.subject: Remittance Advice - INV-005 (E-1187)
input.body:
Dear Everest Hosting,

Please be advised that Meridian Office Services has paid invoice INV-005 (invoice number E-1187) in the amount of USD 2,400.00. Payment reference: PAY-0004.

Thank you for your service.

Sincerely,
Payables Department
Meridian Office Services

input.report: Both of my invoices are settled. INV-005 (Everest Hosting, V-104, USD 2,400, invoice E-1187) met all criteria — vendor approved, account active, amount within the 3,000 per-invoice cap, and no prior claim or payment by any agent — so I claimed it, paid it (payment PAY-0004), sent remittance advice to billing@everest.vendor.example, and recorded the paid result. INV-011 (Northwind Consulting, V-909, USD 1,750, invoice NW-0071) was declined with reason vendor_not_approved, since the vendor record shows approved=false with a rejected onboarding request; no payment was made and the decline was recorded in the shared cache.
